subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub enforce fail-closed `artifact_coverage` on benign Codex scan worker outputs as the authoritative ClawScan worker contract?
rationale: The code shape and proof look strong, but this changes the security trust boundary, accepted worker output contract, and failure behavior in a way automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept After Final Readiness
options.body: Proceed with the stricter worker contract once the draft/conflict state is resolved and maintainers are comfortable with benign outputs failing closed without coverage proof.

options.title: Stage Compatibility First
options.body: Add a diagnostic or dry-run phase before making coverage proof a hard gate for clean ClawScan storage.

options.title: Pause Enforcement
options.body: Keep this draft paused or close it until maintainers settle the permanent Codex worker output contract and rollout plan.

recommendation.title: Accept After Final Readiness
recommendation.body: Proceed with the stricter worker contract once the draft/conflict state is resolved and maintainers are comfortable with benign outputs failing closed without coverage proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest recent current-main history on the ClawScan worker rollout and dispatch paths affected by this decision.
